module: gameplayStatistic module that detects burnouts: an intact driven wheel spins (wheel speed > 2 and > 1.5 x ground speed, load-weighted slip > 4) while touching the ground. At the end, if the duration exceeds 0.1 s, adds the metric 'vehicle/burnout.time' (aggregated).
notes: Unloads itself if the main controller is not 'vehicleController/vehicleController', or if there are no wheels or no driven wheel (wd.isPropulsed).
Ignored if the wheel count has changed since load.
Per-wheel condition: not isBroken, wheelSpeed > 2, wheelSpeed > groundSpeed * 1.5, lastSlip * min(downForce * 0.1, 1) > 4, ground contact.
The workload is not registered here (the addSchedule call is commented out); it is gameplayStatistic that adds it to the scheduler.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Called on load: lists the driven wheels; returns false to unload if the vehicle is not suitable.

workload.desc: Watch function run in turn by gameplayStatistic: detects burnout start/end and sends the metric.
